constraints: pathObject must contain the properties: parentFolder (Text, directory info; last character must be a folder separator -- '/' selects a Posix-style path, otherwise the system separator is used), name (Text, final file/folder name without extension), extension (Text, starts with '.', can be omitted, empty string '' if none) and isFolder (Boolean, defaults to false).
Only builds a string: it does not validate the path's syntax against the chosen path type, nor check that any file or folder actually exists.
pathObject is typically produced by Path to object, but can be built by any means.
